confirmDelete: Delete this SuperEvent? (loc + picture + sprite will all be removed from export)
title: SuperEvent Workbench · super events (fullscreen image + soundtrack + 5-segment copy)
intro: A two-pane workbench for HOI4 fullscreen ceremonial events: write the 5-segment copy, soundtrack, and 460×310 image. Click + New SuperEvent to start. On export, the scripted_effects / scripted_guis and interface .gui / .gfx you need are generated along with each event — you don't write them by hand.
emptyAllHint: Fullscreen ceremonial popups — art, soundtrack, five-part copy.
selectHint: Select a SuperEvent on the left to edit · or click "+ New".
tagLabel: Owner country TAG (empty = project main country)
incrementalUpdate: Incremental update (only the fields below change · others kept)
delayLabel: Startup delay in days (used with auto_fire)
autoFireLabel: Auto-fire on startup (on_startup auto-fire · checked for most super events)
dormantWarning: ⚠ Auto-fire on startup is off. If nothing else in the project — event, focus, or decision — references it via <mono> country_event = {tag}_se.{number} </mono>, the whole set (events.txt, yml, images, scripted_loc) is skipped on export, so you don't ship files that never fire.
optionsEmpty: By default there's one "Continue" button that just closes the SuperEvent, with no effect. Click "+ Add button" to add more options; put <mono>{snippet}</mono> in an effect to chain to the next SuperEvent or a regular event.
effectHint: Runs when the player chooses this option. Use a template as a safe starting point, or write any valid HOI4 effect block.
emptyHeroTitle: Super events are your story's big moments
previewUnavailable: Super events have no in-game preview yet — the picture and all five copy segments are visible in the editor.
